text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap seems
rather down in the dumps...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I just haven't been able to shake off my fatigue lately.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm eating properly, so
I don't think there should be any problem, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I don't quite get it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've worn her out quite a bit.
I might need to rethink our race schedule.
